reasoning: Source-only inspection of [panel.png] identified a linear main x axis labelled Relative Pressure (P/P₀), a linear y axis labelled Uptake (cm³ g⁻¹), a blue open-circle solid-line series directly annotated CO2@195 K, and a coral open-circle N2@77 K series that is not eligible. The embedded inset is excluded by the native mask [247,173,540,440] and was not counted or calibrated. Independent tick-stroke fits used native major-tick centres rather than candidate values. The resulting residuals are 0.239 px RMS in x and 0.161 px RMS in y, improving on the supplied rounded-tick fit; every saved x/y value was recomputed from its native centre. After calibration and species verification, all 55 Agent 03 rows were checked against unchanged pixels and the full review inventory [adjudicate/review_tiles.json]. Forty-three candidate rows were retained, one retained source instance was moved to the centre of its visible partial ring, twelve candidate rows in continuous fused ink were deleted as unsupported specific centres, and six omitted native rings/partial rings were added. The additions are supported by visible white interiors and blue circular contours in [panel.png] or [crowded_strip:01], not by expected counts, curve fits, or interpolation. The saved CSV therefore contains 49 direct or partially visible CO2 markers and no N2 or inset rows. Two native low-pressure bands remain unresolved because continuous saturated blue ink hides any separable glyph centre; no rows were fabricated there. Reloaded-CSV reconstruction and native overlay checks place all exported centres on the blue main-panel curve, outside the inset mask and inside the frame. Verdict is review because marker recall cannot be declared complete in the unresolved fused bands.
